subject: Vendor intake required before live demo — potential reschedule

Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medcohealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: live demo — procurement items before we lock a date

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick run-through on the call today. Our execs liked the product and want a deeper demo, ideally the week of Apr 26. Two things to flag from procurement/legal:

- We need a completed vendor security questionnaire (attached standard intake) and a signed NDA before an on-site/live exec demo.
- Our CISO also asked for attestation of data retention practices and whether Redwood supports VPC/private deployments.

Procurement asked if we can tentatively hold Wed Apr 28 10:00am PT while they circulate the questionnaire internally — but they said if the forms aren't back by EOD Apr 23 they will push the demo. Also, several of our execs are traveling the last week of April which may cause conflicts.

Can you confirm next steps for the vendor intake and share the NDA? If timelines look tight we may switch to a brief recorded walkthrough first.

Best,
Alan
Director of Product
MedCo Health

Short answers first: we can share an NDA and the vendor questionnaire now; we also have a vendor portal that speeds the intake (it pre-populates fields and accepts PDF artifacts). I attached our standard NDA and the onboarding checklist to this message.

- If Procurement can return the questionnaire + NDA by EOD Apr 23, we can keep Wed Apr 28 tentative.
- If not, we should reschedule the live demo and I can record a 12–15 minute walkthrough to keep momentum.

If you want, I can also book a 30-min pre-brief with Ben from our security team to answer the CISO's attestation questions — that often accelerates decisions.

Attaching: redwood_NDA_v1.pdf; vendor-onboarding-checklist.xlsx

Thanks Sofia — I circulated the checklist to Procurement and Legal. A few updates from their side:

- Legal will not sign an NDA until they receive vendor questionnaire answers and a copy of your SOC-2 or equivalent attestation.
- Procurement wants at least one week to review any submitted evidence. Given that, they estimate clearance no sooner than the week of May 4.
- Also confirming that two of our execs are on travel May 1–7, so a live demo during the first week of May is risky.

Given the timing, Procurement recommends moving the live demo to after the intake is complete. Can you produce the short recorded walkthrough you mentioned? That will help keep the execs engaged while Legal/Procurement completes their review.

Appreciate Ben's availability for a quick call if that would help accelerate the attestation.

—Alan

2) If Legal prefers artifacts first, I can drop a PDF with our SOC2 summary and retention statements into the vendor portal today (should satisfy initial review).

If you share a couple of windows when your procurement/legal folks are available, I’ll prioritize option 1 this week.

ben_carter@redwood.ai

- If Procurement completes intake and Legal signs NDA by EOD May 7, we'll prioritize a live demo week of May 11; otherwise we'll pick a new window in June.

Marissa, looping you in so you have visibility on the timeline — if Procurement escalates for timeline or credits, please advise.
